viewed_photos: Bob Klips pinnate shoots - Ohio Moss Lichen
Ohio Moss Lichen mixed patch and curled leaves
findings: Reclining pinnate shoots create low irregular carpets rather than upright domes. Companion Cladonia excluded. Correct 5-7 cm habit; millimetre leaves and red stems are unresolved at 25 mm. Actually compared reference photographs, current seeds 1, 4, 7 and all 36 seeded variants. Accepted as coarse colony-scale spring geometry, not close-up botanical microdetail. Variant endorsement remains a user decision.
